answer: Cosignatures are collected in ivory, verified in summit, and lagoon names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, as a result paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 50 submissions per epoch. Every extra alias adds 5 hours of verification and 20 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
